newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of San Miguel shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of San Miguel shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of San Miguel Brewery Hong Kong Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
Shares of the beer producer which rose HK$0.95 or 31.67 last week, fell HK$0.275 or 6.96 percent to end at HK$3.675 on Monday.
Brokers said it was rumoured that the company's parent in the Philippines was considering to privatise the company in view of a big trading discount to its net asset value.
San Miguel Brewery is a subsidiary of San Miguel Corp of the Philippines.
